extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT payable before grant of probate can be applied for
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £361,000 Chester estate, mostly the deceased's home with little cash, enquires about borrowing £39,000 to pay inheritance tax due by 17 December.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about a probate loan in connection with the estate you are administering in Chester. We have noted the gross estate value of approximately £361,000, the £39,000 requested towards the inheritance tax liability, and the 17 December tax date. To take this further we would need confirmation of the executors' details and identification, a copy of the will and the draft IHT account, details of the property (title, valuation and any charges), and confirmation of any other estate assets, liabilities or beneficiary interests. Once we have those we can review the enquiry and come back to you. Please do let us know if any of the figures above have changed.
